motion_rule: a bird tied to her savings preaches about wings. She holds one wire while the laundry flies. Lines run across frame, not into depth. Shot size changes every beat as in c
character: a slim grey turtle dove, pink breast, black neck ring, head stabbing the air
second_characters: ONE sparrow with nothing on him: lands, preens, leaves
props: ONE thick dark red thread from her toe to a coin nest on the ledge; ONE rolled banknote
prop_continuity: the red thread shows from 0.55 on; the banknote rides down it at 5.80 and onto her face at 9.35
environment: washing lines between sunlit yards at noon, sheets and pillowcases
light_events: blazing noon, sheets bouncing white light on her breast

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: soft cooing female voice gone hard, preaching, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ot-LO-zhish, CHOR-ny, pri-DYOT, CHOR-na-ya, DEN-gi, spa-SUT, TOL-ko, KRY-lya
audio.pacing: 1.30-3.15, 3.65-5.25 and 7.30-9.35 each one breath; after 9.35 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: her beak opens wide and shapes every syllable, throat swelling
audio.sfx: wind, sheets cracking, the wire humming, coins dropping

timeline.a: a gust rips a sheet off and throws her off the wire; her wings snap open by reflex
she drops back and hauls the red thread tight with her beak, knotting it to her toe
she loops the red thread round her toe again and pulls the knot hard
a test tug slides the coin nest along the ledge toward the edge
she puffs her throat out and holds it
a pillowcase fills with wind behind her and bangs
the sparrow drops on the wire, it sags, and she catches her balance mid word
a loose sheet sweeps behind her; the wind lifts her nape into a crest
she turns her head sharp to profile and holds a prophet pause
a towel tears off the line and goes across the yard
without leaving her pose she tugs the thread and a rolled banknote slides into her foot
she pushes the banknote under her breast feathers and sits on it like an egg
she looks into the lens and says nothing, one toe drawing the thread tighter
she squares her shoulders, throat swollen
the sparrow preens a feather and does not look up
she rises on her toes, wings half lifting
she throws both wings wide and pushes off; the nest slides off the ledge
the thread snaps her upside down: toe still hooked over the wire, wings beating hard, neck arching up at her own foot, beak snapping, the banknote landing on her face
the nest swings on the same thread facing her, dripping coins into the yard, while she snaps at the sparrow and misses

must_appear: the red thread runs from her toe to the nest all clip and her own tugs slide it to the edge; at 9.35 she hangs upside down beating her wings and snapping, alive and furious; coins leave one at a time
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, a dead bird, a limp bird, wings hanging loose, a bird hanging motionless, a thread on her neck, a parked camera, a closed beak while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines, cyrillic letters, words
